This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Chapter 6" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|purple]] skin with white markings around their faces.<ref name="Chapter 6" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="9 ABY Date">{{BoBFDate}}</ref> a member of the species was present at [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary]] in [[Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine]] when the [[Pyke Syndicate]] destroyed it.<ref name="Chapter 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger|sixth episode]] of the [[2021]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', directed by [[
Dave Filoni]].<ref name="Chapter 6" />
